hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in [fF][aA][lL][sS][eE]|0|[nN][oO]|[oO][fF][fF]) ;; *) [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-}" ] || exit 0; [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/node_modules/.bin/oxlint" ] && diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" . && npm install --loglevel=error) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: Install oxlint into the plugin data directory at session start, used only when the project has no local oxlint and none is on PATH. Turn off to skip it.
